top_stories.title: Amazon acquires key assets of AI startup Decart for reported $7.5B
top_stories.description: Amazon.com Inc. today announced plans to hire the technical staff of startup Decart.AI Inc. and acquire its core technology. The company didn’t disclose the terms of the deal. However, sources told Bloomberg that Amazon is paying about $7.5 billion. That’s nearly twice the valuation Decart reportedly received after its most recent funding round in May. top_stories.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
top_stories.description: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

top_stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
top_stories.description: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
